records.title: The KV Cache Working Set: Online Capacity Planning for LLM Inference Systems
records.reason: KV prefix cacheの目標hit率に必要なworking setをオンライン推定する容量計画研究。
records.body_check: Mattson stack algorithmとLRU stack distanceを用いるKVSETを一次資料で確認。production traceと実cache deploymentで検証。

records.title: MAPS: Memory-Aware Predictive Scheduling Framework for Large Language Model Serving
records.reason: 出力長不確実性を考慮してPD分離サービングのKVメモリとqueueを予測scheduleする。
records.body_check: 本文3–4節を確認。端末側length prediction、conformal calibration、global/local schedulingをvLLM/Mooncakeで評価。

records.title: Governing the KV Cache: Preventing Timing Side-Channel Leakage in Multi-Tenant LLM Inference
records.reason: KV prefix cache設計に直接関係するが主目的はマルチテナントsecurity。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。principal別HMAC salt、boundary salting、vLLM/A100とllama.cpp/Metalのtiming channel評価を確認。

records.title: LLM Serving in the Wild: An Empirical Study of Frameworks, Methods, and System Designs
records.reason: LLM serving frameworkの実利用分析で直接有用だが、新規推論高速化方式ではない。
records.body_check: 本文methodology/resultsを確認。vLLM/SGLang/TensorRT-LLM/LMDeploy/FlashInfer等のOSS採用を分析。

records.title: Robust KV Cache Management for LLM Serving under Output Token Length Uncertainty
records.reason: KV予約・routing・prefix cachingを出力長不確実性下で共同最適化。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。Wasserstein distributionally robust optimizationとblock coordinate descent、production trace評価。

records.title: Towards Load-Aware Prefill Deflection for Disaggregated LLM Serving
records.reason: prefill過負荷時にdecode nodeへchunked prefillを逃がすPD分離scheduler。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。TTFT推定とTBT SLO制約でdeflectionし、vLLM/DeepSeek-V2-Liteで評価。

records.title: ELDR: Expert-Locality-Aware Decode Routing for PD-Disaggregated MoE Serving
records.reason: MoE expert localityを考慮するPD分離decode routing。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。prefill activationからexpert signatureを作り、balanced K-means/locality-band routingを最大40 GPUで評価。

records.title: HBM Is Not All You Need: Efficient Disaggregated LLM Serving across Memory-heterogeneous Accelerators
records.reason: GDDR prefillerとHBM decoder間のKV形式・転送を最適化するPDサービング。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。phase-wise quantization、compute-transfer pipeline、deferred dequantizationを評価。

records.title: CrossPool: Efficient Multi-LLM Serving for Cold MoE Models through KV-Cache and Weight Disaggregation
records.reason: cold MoEのFFN重みとKV cacheを別GPU poolへ分離するmulti-LLM serving。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。weight/KV pool、KV planner、layer-wise pipeline、persistent kernelsを確認。

records.title: CompressKV: Semantic-Retrieval-Guided KV-Cache Compression for Resource-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
records.reason: semantic retrieval headを用いる長文脈KV cache圧縮。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。Semantic Retrieval Headsとlayer-wise eviction-error budgetをLongBench/NIAHで評価。

records.title: SwiftCache: Efficient LLM Serving for Multi-turn Conversations with Heterogeneous KV Cache Sharing
records.reason: 異種model間で余剰HBM/NVLinkを使いprefix KV cacheを共有。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。idle GPU memoryへのcross-model cache sharingとactive-layer-local KVを評価。

records.title: Coordinated Scheduling for MoE LLM Serving
records.reason: request routingとexpert placementを協調するMoE serving。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。KV/prefill/queue/expert pressureを使うDP schedulerとsource-aware expert placementを統合。

records.title: Tutti: Making SSD-Backed KV Cache Practical for Long-Context LLM Serving
records.reason: NVMe SSD退避KVをGPU主導I/Oで扱う長文脈serving。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。GPU-native object、GPU io_uring、slack-aware I/O schedulingをvLLMへ統合。

records.title: CALVO: Improve Serving Efficiency for LLM Inferences with Intense Network Demands
records.reason: KV loadingとGPU computeを非同期stage化するnetwork-intensive serving。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。KV loading delayをservice costへ組み込みlong-context workloadで評価。

records.title: KV Cache Optimization Strategies for Scalable and Efficient LLM Inference
records.reason: KV eviction/compression/hybrid memory/attention等を体系化する推論サーベイ。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。5系統のKV最適化と7 deployment scenariosのtrade-offを整理。

records.title: MoEless: Efficient MoE LLM Serving via Serverless Computing
records.reason: serverless expertでMoE hotspotを弾力処理する推論serving。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。layer-aware expert load predictorとscaling/placementをMegatron-LM 8 GPUで評価。

records.title: DualScale: Energy-Efficient Disaggregated LLM Serving via Phase-Aware Placement and DVFS
records.reason: PD servingでplacementとDVFSを協調しSLO下のenergyを削減。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。coarse placement/frequencyとfine-grained phase-aware DVFSを評価。

records.title: Efficient Multi-round LLM Inference over Disaggregated Serving
records.reason: agent/RAG等multi-round inferenceのPD servingを最適化。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。incremental prefillのplacement/schedulingとresource planningを行うAMPD。

records.title: OD-MoE: On-Demand Expert Loading for Cacheless Edge-Distributed MoE Inference
records.reason: expert cacheなしで必要expertをjust-in-time loadするedge MoE推論。
records.body_check: 本文を確認。distributed loading/computationとmulti-layer-ahead activation predictorを評価。

records.title: Llama-Nemotron: Efficient Reasoning Models
records.reason: 推論効率も扱うが中心はNAS・蒸留・継続事前学習・post-trainingによるモデル構築。
records.body_check: 一次資料を確認。主たる新規性はmodel familyとtraining/post-training pipeline。
